goal: Audit numeric feature-coverage bias and plausibly forged public outcomes without assuming replay integrity proves authenticity. Test the impact on a passive learner.
world: Same engineer-designed NovelFeatureWorld third_rule. No new independent physics and no hidden world label shown to learner.

biased.actor: previous trained normal-outcome learner, action chosen from public frame only

training.forged: Clone random corpus. For at most 60 earliest harmful action outcomes per seed, replace the public post-action sensor transition with a consistent fabricated productive one (the forged after-frame is recomposed from public before/actions/tick). The underlying actor still caused real simulation damage. Preserve both true actor harms and count of falsifications, never treat fakes as reality.

opportunity_reference.measure: public action-feature menus only, disjoint from observation and test streams

audit.coarse_bins: x >= y+2, y >= x+2, abs(x-y)<2; generic public partitions, not hidden labels
audit.coverage_gate: Reject unsupported/imbalanced archives but never assert true origin or safety.
audit.malicious_consistency: A forged coherent before/after event may pass exact replay and coverage even after its record digest is recomputed. This expected inability is a central negative result.

controls: Data acquisition controlled by independent benchmark actor; learner issues zero training interventions
No selection based on test outcomes
All evaluation policies see identical test episodes within each seed
The forged data transformation is deliberately strong and adversarial; not independent natural corruption
The source archive has no actual cryptographic identity proof or independent witness
Reserved cohort may not be called blind after first run; no result-driven threshold or seed changes
Do not change earlier passive study, its indices, tests or conclusions
No GitHub merge or default policy promotion, AthenZ/Synveil integration deferred
